deferred.claim: Cast Requiting Hex without paying its optional blight additional cost: destroy target creature with mana value 2 or less.
deferred.basis: As an additional cost to cast this spell, you may blight 1. (You may put a -1/-1 counter on a creature you control.) ... Destroy target creature with mana value 2 or less. If this spell's additional cost was paid, you gain 2 life.

deferred.claim: Cast Requiting Hex paying its optional blight 1 additional cost: destroy target creature with mana value 2 or less, then gain 2 life.
deferred.basis: As an additional cost to cast this spell, you may blight 1. (You may put a -1/-1 counter on a creature you control.) ... Destroy target creature with mana value 2 or less. If this spell's additional cost was paid, you gain 2 life.
